F8486583.notes: First LV-5 Kestrel flight. The direct, phase-timed ascent worked and Junction ended 300 m from Node 1. At separation the booster computer asked Trajectories for a prediction while it was not the active vessel; the script crashed and the stage was lost. Fixed 2026-11-06: the booster waits for the FMRS replay and every Trajectories call checks the active vessel. Junction was terminated before docking. Logged with the old single-file logger: no ground track for this flight.
